result.summary: The page generally renders well with a consistent design and readable contrast. The main minor visual issue is a restaurant title in the horizontal carousel that is clipped at the right screen edge.

issues.description: The truncated restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off by the right screen edge and appears to overflow the available card width instead of being properly ellipsized or wrapped.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles are constrained to the card width and use proper text truncation or wrapping.
